series: JLPT N3 grammar series; denominator = 220 Bunpro N3 entries (n3-coverage-matrix, frozen)
levelPolicy: Bunpro precedence (docs/jlpt-levels.md); Rule A owning level kept for reused items; new items classified by the complete visible contrast; Rule B both Sensei and SKM at N3; Rule C N2 only where the exact sense is supported at N2 and N3 placement cannot be verified.

primarySources.use: N3 のに 'in order to': Verb (non-past) + のに; examples with 買った, 使う, かかる, 必要な. Its examples include acquiring a tool for a use (本を読むのに眼鏡を買った); because ために is also possible in many such frames, the set practises purpose のに only by interpretation of supplied のに sentences (purpose versus concessive のに).
N3 ため(に) for purpose and cause; notes that 〜のに and 〜ために are often interchangeable for purpose; そのため as the sentence-initial form.
Cause ために (row 34); covered by formal-nouns-causes.
N3 〜からこそ 'precisely because', emphasising the reason; follows plain forms including Nだ.
N3 〜ばかりに 'simply because', a cause leading to an undesirable result; 〜たいばかりに; Nである／なである before it.
N3 〜ことから 'from the fact that', the basis for a judgment, and the origin of a name.
N2 〜ことだから 'knowing (someone)'; listed so that it was not used as an N3 contrast.
N3 〜という理由で 'on the grounds that', a reason given (sometimes a pretext).
N3 そのため(に) 'for that reason / to that end', sentence-initial connective.
N3 なぜなら(ば)〜から(だ) 'the reason is that', formal or written.

supplementarySources.supports: Row statuses and existing exercise IDs for rows 32, 33, 34, 39, 43 and 205.

dispositions.note: Existing purpose のに practice is interpretation (noni-contrasts meaning items). New items are also interpretation, with new sentences: supplied のに sentences labelled 目的 (purpose) or 逆接 (concessive), three of each (construction noni-concessive is the contrast side; jlpt 3 because the task needs the N3 purpose sense). Production against ために was dropped because ために is acceptable in many purpose-のに frames.

Covered elsewhere. Three new purpose items (dictionary form + ために for a goal; Noun + のために for a goal and a beneficiary) sit on the ため side of the grounds-or-cause relationship (construction tame, covering cause and purpose), decided because ことから cannot state what an action is for; jlpt 3 because ため(に) and ことから are both Bunpro N3 rows.

Covered elsewhere. One new cause item (Noun + のために, a reported delay) on the ため side of the grounds-or-cause relationship; the clause + ために physical-result item was replaced by a purpose item because formal ことから narration can also introduce a physical result. jlpt 3 because cause ために and ことから are both Bunpro N3 rows.
Covered elsewhere; article mention only. No new exercises.
Covered elsewhere; the article compares it with からこそ, and the emphatic-cause group links to formal-nouns-causes-credit-or-blame. Not used as an option (that would require new targets).
Covered elsewhere; the article compares it with ばかりに. Not used as an option (that would require new targets).
NEWL light entry (3 items); closings varied (のです, のだ, ためだ) so that the direction of the link, not the ending, decides the items.

Interpretation of supplied からこそ sentences against ばかりに (labels 大事な理由／それだけの原因 defined by what the connective does, fixed order), because a からこそ/ばかりに cloze would always be keyed からこそ. Includes Nであるからこそ, 〜てくれたからこそ今の私がある and a deliberate, unwelcome-looking result (厳しいことを言う).

Interpretation of supplied ばかりに sentences (labels 大事な理由／それだけの原因 with readings and definitions, fixed order), because からこそ remains grammatical as a cloze competitor even with regret. Verb past, negative past, い-adjective, 〜たいばかりに.
NEWL light entry (3 items): two cause uses and one 'to that end' use; そのために accepted.

Evidence-for-judgment sense, contrasted with ため(に) (reversed causation on the ことから items; a cause or a goal on the ため items). The naming use (〜ことから〜と呼ばれる) is article-only because ために is arguably also acceptable there. ことだから (Bunpro N2) is article-only; using it as an option would raise the items to N2.

NEWL light entry (3 items) tested by position (inside the sentence, after a quote, Noun+だ or a past verb); all 9 reason-connective items offer the same three options, and on the six sentence-initial items という理由で is ruled out because the blank opens a new sentence. The stated-grounds/pretext nuance is in the explanations and article.

groups.reason: Purpose のに/ために sits next to the existing purpose-or-cause material.
Emphatic reasons extend the reasons material in reasons-contrasts-and-listing.
Evidence versus cause is a reason-type decision.
Sentence-level reason connectives extend basic から／ので.

vocabulary.policy: Local displayed-form readings/glosses; no canonical word references; blank protected as grammar-target.

reviewLimits: No physical-device rendering check was performed.
Model-authored; independent model reviews recorded by the coordinator.

independentReview.method: Three blind single-facet reviews, each by a fresh agent with a different requested model family, given only the frozen render, raw set JSON, article and ledger: A linguistic correctness, B consistency and quiz safety, C learner comprehensibility. Findings were consolidated by the coordinator, applied by the author, and sent back to the original reviewers for a per-finding disposition.
independentReview.actualModelNote: The runtime does not expose the served model; the requested model is recorded.

reviews.finalVerdict: all findings resolved after four rounds; no new findings

findings.claim: ばかりに cloze items were not decided against からこそ by the context.
findings.change: Round 1 added visible minimisers and regret; rounds 2 and 3 converted all ばかりに and からこそ items to interpretation items on supplied sentences, with function-defined labels 大事な理由 and それだけの原因 in a fixed order.

findings.claim: からこそ versus ばかりに was not decided by the context.
findings.change: Redesigned so B gratefully credits the teaching (先生が厳しく教えてくれた____、今の私があるんです); explanation gender-neutral.

findings.claim: Purpose ために was also possible.
findings.change: Replaced; purpose のに is now practised by interpretation (noni-laundry-dry, noni-books-cost) and by noni-box-books (この箱は、本を入れるのにちょうどいい大きさだ).

findings.location: のに／ために rationales and article
findings.claim: 'ために needs deliberate action' overgeneralised.
findings.change: Stated as a tendency; the article describes のに as typical with かかる／使う／必要／便利／役に立つ, not as an exclusive rule.

findings.location: からこそ／ばかりに definitions; たいばかりに
findings.claim: Definitions were imprecise and たいばかりに was not distinguished.
findings.change: からこそ = emphasis on the decisive reason; ばかりに = one cause alone was enough, typically undesired; たいばかりに explained separately.

findings.location: ことから rationales; tame-roadworks and its replacements
findings.claim: 'No ことから after Noun + の' was wrong, and later replacements (fever, wind-tree, doctor) were still defensible with ことから or ために.
findings.change: Claim removed; tame-exam-library (goal, not a known fact) and tame-children-move (Noun + の excludes のに) replace them; the article states that ことから introduces a known fact, never a goal.

findings.location: なぜなら rationales and article
findings.claim: なぜなら was said to require 〜から(だ).
findings.change: Now 'normally pairs with' 〜から(だ).

reviews.finalVerdict: all findings resolved after a round-4 check; no new findings

findings.claim: Option inventories and instructions predicted the key.
findings.change: One instruction and one option set (なぜなら, そのため, という理由で) on all nine items, with context-specific rationales.

findings.claim: Sentence closings (からだ versus のだ) predicted the key.
findings.change: Closings varied so reason-versus-result direction decides; umbrella now closes with のです.

findings.claim: The slot form decided the key.
findings.change: Slot is now 家族である____, where both forms fit and the valued-versus-regretted reading decides.

findings.claim: Malformed controls decided items by form.
findings.change: Merged with CAUS-A-06; rationales argue from meaning.

findings.claim: The context did not decide からこそ.
findings.change: Merged with CAUS-A-02.

findings.claim: Glosses for てしまう, たった and 期待する were misleading.
findings.change: てしまう 'end up'; たった 'only, a mere'; 期待する 'expect; hope'.

findings.claim: Some facets had a single example key.
findings.change: Shared keys per repeated frame; every facet has at least two keys.

findings.location: からこそ／ばかりに interpretation labels
findings.claim: Round 3: the valence wording of the labels predicted the key.
findings.change: Labels defined by function (大事な理由, それだけの原因); valence appears only as 'typically'.

findings.claim: Round 4: 「のに、」 with a comma appeared on every 逆接 item and on no 目的 item.
findings.change: Comma removed from noni-wait-bus, noni-practice-improve and noni-hurry-hour; new 逆接 item noni-jogging-weight with a dictionary-form verb; keys 目的 3 / 逆接 4. Reviewer confirmed that no surface feature predicts the key.

reviews.finalVerdict: all findings resolved; optional round-4 points applied

findings.claim: Instructions differed per item and were hard to follow.
findings.change: Merged with CAUS-B-01; the interpretation instruction was later shortened to about 240 characters.

findings.claim: Idiom not glossed.
findings.change: Glossed as an idiom.

findings.claim: The cue for 'gone home' was unclear.
findings.change: Uses 入り口にくつもない.

findings.claim: Stray （かんさい） reading.
findings.change: Removed.

findings.claim: Gendered reference to the teacher.
findings.change: Explanation is gender-neutral.

findings.claim: Round 4: 大事な書類 echoed the label 大事な理由; the ことから rationale was long.
findings.change: 大事な書類 → 重要な書類; ことから rationale trimmed.
